channel.title: South Africa - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from South Africa, every source cited.

item.title: Two arrested for election offences in Limpopo
item.description: Suspects detained for tearing down posters and assault ahead of local government elections.

item.title: SAHRC flags R777m tanker bill amid Gauteng water crisis
item.description: The South African Human Rights Commission found infrastructure failure, not water shortage, causes outages.

item.title: US to suspend South Africa's duty-free trade access
item.description: Washington cites trade barriers and other practices inconsistent with the AGOA agreement.

item.title: South Africa's power outlook relies on uncertain assumptions
item.description: A new 10-year electricity plan faces doubts after a failed gas tender and ambitious Eskom targets.

item.title: South Africa launches new insecticide for potato moths
item.description: Syngenta’s SILVALIS®, powered by PLINAZOLIN® technology, offers a new mode of action for crop protection.
